2608.11805.title: Hybrid Gated Attention
2608.11805.paper_summary: Gated attention is an effective approach to mitigate attention sinks and enhance the representational capacity of attention. To further extend its effectiveness-efficiency Pareto frontier, we propose a Hybrid Gated Attention (HyGA) framework that contains three types of gating strategies. Specifically, these gates leverage diverse information from multiple stages of attention, and collaboratively build element-wise/head-wise gating from multiple perspectives, capturing intra-head and cross-head information interactions. Through our hybrid gating components, HyGA could provide multi-source modulation signals, enabling more comprehensive control over information flow and improving the representational capacity of attention. We also introduce low-rank matrix decomposition and learnable attention sink to further enhance training efficiency and stability. In experiments, we evaluate HyGA on widely-used benchmarks based on different backbones. The experimental results show that our HyGA comprehensively improves both training loss and various downstream performances compared with Gated attention. HyGA has also been verified to achieve the best performance at different computation costs, with comprehensive model analyses for better understanding. The proposed HyGA sheds light on a more effective, efficient, and stable attention mechanism.
2608.11805.paper_summary_zh: 有閘注意力是一種有效的方法，可以減輕注意力的沉沒效應並增強注意力的表徵能力。為了進一步擴展其有效性-效率的Pareto邊界，我們提出了一個混合閘注意力（HyGA）框架，該框架包含三種類型的閘策略。具體而言，這些閘利用來自多個注意力階段的多樣信息，並從多個角度協同構建元素級/頭級的閘，捕捉頭內和頭間的信息交互。通過我們的混合閘組件，HyGA可以提供多源調制信號，使信息流的控制更加全面，並提高注意力的表徵能力。我們還引入了低秩矩陣分解和可學習的注意力沉沒效應，以進一步提高訓練效率和穩定性。在實驗中，我們在基於不同骨幹的廣泛使用的基準上評估了HyGA。實驗結果顯示，與有閘注意力相比，我們的HyGA在訓練損失和各種下游性能方面全面改善。HyGA還被驗證在不同計算成本下實現最佳性能，並進行了全面的模型分析以便更好地理解。所提出的HyGA為更有效、高效和穩定的注意力機制提供了啟示。
